outcome: Canonical derived CharacterHandle construction now reserves suffix width in UTF-16 units, truncates only on code-point boundaries, validates the final value through characterHandleSchema, and is used by duplicate and handoff collision writers.

implementation.detail: Exports characterHandleSchema as the one handle brand boundary and deriveCharacterHandle as the suffix-reserving constructor. The constructor budgets with JavaScript UTF-16 length, walks source code points to avoid splitting surrogate pairs, refuses a suffix that leaves no source, and brands only through schema.parse.
Routes -copy and numbered -copy-N candidates through deriveCharacterHandle while preserving deterministic first-free search.
Routes numbered handoff collision candidates through deriveCharacterHandle while preserving the bounded 2..50 search.
